sources.label: Morphe patches for Earth Super Wallpaper — AOSP unlock and idle-animation fix
sources.author: Machu
patch_list: Delays the AOD zoom-out on screen-off so the device's closing animation can finish first. The delay is configurable (default 500 ms).

Makes the official Earth Super Wallpaper work on non-MIUI Android: removes MIUI framework crashes, fixes ambient-mode and weather settings, adds the five desk positions, restores the unlock animation, and keeps picker applies stable.
